text:
liam: hey team, just started today. ran through the quickstart and tried `rwd-kube login --env dev` but `kubectl config get-contexts` still only shows my local `kind` context. not sure where the redwood contexts went. anyone know who handles kubeconfigs for new hires? :wave:
cara: welcome liam! typically `rwd-kube` merges into `~/.kube/config`. can you paste `echo $KUBECONFIG` and `ls -la ~/.kube`? sometimes people have config fragments.
liam: `echo $KUBECONFIG` prints `/Users/liam/.kube/config.backup`, and `ls -la` shows `config` and `config.backup`. i did the login with default creds though.
cara: ah that explains it. kubectl uses KUBECONFIG env var if set — your shell is pointing at the backup file. either unset KUBECONFIG or include both files in the env: `export KUBECONFIG=$HOME/.kube/config:$HOME/.kube/config.backup` then `kubectl config view --merge` will show merged contexts.
liam: unset and reran `rwd-kube login` — now I have a `redwood-dev-gke-01-liam` context showing. tried `kubectl get pods -n infra-platform-dev` and got `Forbidden` error.
cara: did you request namespace access in the onboarding form? new-hires usually get `view` by default; `edit` needs a dev manager request. ping infra if you need edit.
liam: i filled the form for infra-platform edit. who tags infra?
infra: hey @liam, infra here. i see a pending request for liam in the onboarding queue. i provisioned a RoleBinding for the Okta group `okta:team-infra-platform` yesterday. double-check whether your SSO subject is the group or the user. run `kubectl auth can-i get pods -n infra-platform-dev --as=system:serviceaccount:default:default` (ignore the SA part) or `kubectl auth can-i list pods -n infra-platform-dev`.
liam: `kubectl auth can-i list pods -n infra-platform-dev` returns `no`. infra-bot earlier created a binding with the user principal instead of the Okta group, so it did not match.
infra: thanks — i fixed the RoleBinding to reference `group:okta:team-infra-platform` instead of the individual. applied the update.
infra-bot: rolebinding "rb-team-infra-platform-dev" applied in namespace "infra-platform-dev" for subject "group:okta:team-infra-platform" at 2026-04-01T14:11:10Z
liam: retrying `kubectl get pods -n infra-platform-dev` — works now, can see pods and port-forward into a debug pod. big thanks! :tada:
cara: adding a note to the new-hires checklist to check KUBECONFIG env var and confirm Okta group binding pattern. welcome aboard again! :rocket:
